name: KanbanTableTH
description: a kanban board table interactive grid header cell for organizing items by status <th>
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `scope="col"` associates the header with its workflow column for assistive technologies
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `colspan`: number (optional) -- number of columns this header cell spans
`rowspan`: number (optional) -- number of rows this header cell spans
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<th>` element
